items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of primary screening using a rotating drum screen;
The Facility is a membrane bioreactor (MBR) system capable of treating up to 50,000 gallons per day (gpd).
a biological and tertiary treatment vessel (anaerobic treatment chamber for denitrification, aerobic treatment chamber for nitrification and membrane filter for microfiltration);
a biological and tertiary treatment vessel (anaerobic treatment chamber for denitrification, aerobic treatment chamber for nitrification and membrane filter for microfiltration);
a biological and tertiary treatment vessel (anaerobic treatment chamber for denitrification, aerobic treatment chamber for nitrification and membrane filter for microfiltration);
an effluent storage tank for backwashing the membrane filter;
a concrete wet well for effluent storage prior to land discharge to the spray field.
A lined, impervious emergency storage basin with a capacity of approximately 300,000 gallons is available for emergency storage.
Biosolids are collected in a 50-gallon plastic container and disposed off-site.

Disinfected tertiary treated wastewater is discharged to either land or to surface water. When discharging to land (1 May 	6 30 September) the effluent is conveyed to the concrete wet well where it is disposed to land (7.5-acre spray field with native grasses and trees) via a sprinkler system.
